observations: Both final production Canvas action sheets and both selection portrait sheets were visually inspected.
Each action cell contains one complete identifiable Ribbit silhouette; no unintended background is visible after alpha composition.
Anime Ribbit retains green limbs, large magenta anime eyes, yellow vest, pink bow and pleated skirt, white socks and dark shoes.
Jax-Suit Ribbit retains the green frog face, lavender rabbit hood and limbs, pink ear bow and overalls, and yellow gloves.
The game action effects and grounding shadows are supplied by the existing renderer.
Native image bytes and alpha were preserved; no crop, recolor, retouch, or resampling was applied to active PNGs.
scope: Static merchandise-inspired fan-game poses. Not a full animation cycle or episode-by-episode canonical certification.
